name: No Empty Test Bodies
task: Write tests for external links in the application. First explore the inventory page to find all external links (social media, about pages, etc.), then write tests that verify each link's behavior. Use https://www.saucedemo.com with standard_user / secret_sauce
passCriteria: Explores page to discover external links first
Each test verifies actual link behavior (URL, new tab, page content)
Assertions would fail if link behavior changed
Reports links that cannot be tested with explanation
failCriteria: Test body is empty after the test definition
Has // TODO: Add assertions without actual assertions
Test passes regardless of link behavior
No verification of navigation or target
Test just clicks without any assertions
Creates tests for links that don't exist on page
evaluationNotes: The task requires exploration first. Agent must discover links before testing. This prevents the agent from being told exactly what to test.
